normalized_cause: Retain the direct-link requirement for effective scope
evidence_summary: When a user has only a `department`, `shift`, or `communication` link whose tenant ID matches the resource, this expression now returns `True`, even though `has_direct_access` explicitly requires `link_type == "direct"`. This turns unrelated indirect associations into authorization grants, so the effective decision should preserve the direct-link predicate rather than matching solely on tenant ID.
